content:
alex: :rotating_light: P1 - multiple Private VPC customers in eu-west1 showing 502/healthcheck failures via ILB. Noticing spike in auth-proxy 401s. Paging @sam (oncall).

oncall-bot: Incident created (P1) by alex at 2026-05-04T12:00:34Z — routing + auth failures impacting Private VPC cross-region failover. PagerDuty alert sent to @sam.

sam: I'm on it. quick summary?

alex: We started seeing backend healthcheck flaps around 11:58Z. ILB logs show upstream auth-proxy returning 401 because a required header X-Custom-Auth got stripped between our egress proxy and the third-party observability aggregator. Pattern matches simultaneous 3rd-party header rewrite that rolled in last hour.

maya: Confirmed from edge logs: 3rd-party proxy (Observix) is returning a 502 for our healthcheck POSTs and also removing Authorization/X-Custom-Auth headers on some TCP flows. Affects cross-region routing when failover triggers.

dina: Is this only eu-west1? any customer reports from us-west1?

alex: Mostly eu-west1 and eu-north. We see cross-region failovers to us-west1 but ILB is dropping because healthchecks are failing after auth failure.

sam: Ok. First mitigation: disable the Observix sidecar/agent for affected nodes and add temporary header passthrough rule on egress proxy. Who can flip the sidecar? @infra_ops?

infra_ops: I can do the sidecar kill, but need a quick confirm on the rollout scope. Suggest patching DaemonSet on cluster-private-eu-west1 to scale down Observix agent to 0 on the next 5 mins.

eng_platform: We can push a cluster patch. Command I'll run:
```
kubectl -n infra patch daemonset observix-agent -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"observix","command":["/bin/true"]}]}}}}' --context=private-eu-west1
```
This will stop the agent from modifying headers without restarting nodes.

sam: Do it. After that we'll validate ILB health. Also add temporary IP-based route to force traffic local to eu-west1 while we validate.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: @sam acknowledged the alert. Escalation triggered to @dina if no update in 15m.

support_lead: I'm drafting a customer note for impacted Private VPC customers: short blurb and ETA for mitigation. Will post to status.redwood if we confirm mitigation working.

(7 minutes later)

eng_platform: observix-agent patched in private-eu-west1. stopping header mutation.

infra_ops: Confirmed agents show 0 CPU. Observix process not running on affected nodes.

alex: Re-running synthetic healthchecks against backends: 200 for most, a few still 502s. ILB is slowly recovering but cross-region failover still shows degraded for some backends.

sam: Next step: temporarily bypass the egress proxy rule that does header normalization for ILB healthcheck user-agent. Maya, can you add a passthrough ACL on the egress proxy?

maya: On it. ACL rule: allow header-preserve for src=10.128.*/32 dst=GCP_ILB_HEALTHCHECK on port 80/443. Pushing now.

maya: ACL deployed. Testing healthchecks...

alex: Healthchecks back to 200 for all eu-west1 backends. ILB has cleared degraded. Cross-region failover stable.

sam: Great. Now we need a durable fix while Observix rolls back their change. Actions: 1) revert Observix rollout with vendor asap; 2) keep header passthrough rule for 1 hour; 3) add explicit signed header check in our auth-proxy to fail closed more gracefully; 4) notify customers + CS. Assign owners?

dina: I'll own vendor coordination and get Observix on a call. cs_lead can you prepare customer comms with list of affected orgs?

cs_lead: On it, pulling list from billing logs and Private VPC configs. Draft ready in 10m.

support_lead: Posting initial status update with guidance: temporary workaround applied, no data plane change required from customer, mitigation in progress. Will update at 13:00Z.

(20 minutes later)

dina: Observix confirmed change pushed inadvertently; they are rolling a rollback but timeline 30-45m. They claim network egress rewrite was toggled in their global edge config.

sam: Good. Meanwhile let's harden our auth-proxy to tolerate missing X-Custom-Auth and attempt token refresh rather than immediate 401 for healthchecks. eng_platform, can we push a config tweak?

eng_platform: We can add healthcheck-specific bypass in auth-proxy: if request path == /_health && header-missing then allow if IP in healthchecker list. Pushing canary to 2 pods now.

eng_platform: Canary deployed to auth-proxy in eu-west1 (2 pods). Monitoring.

alex: Canary looks good — no 401s from those pods. Incrementally rolling to rest of replicas.

(40 minutes later)

dina: Observix rollback complete. They report global edge flags reverted at 12:45Z UTC. Observability team will run diff and provide postmortem.

alex: ILB and auth-proxy metrics normalizing. Healthchecks stable across regions.

sam: OK, de-escalate paging. Keep incident channel open for postmortem. Sam -> handoff to @maya for follow-up and RCA.

pagerduty-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated by sam at 13:00:34Z.

maya: I'll own the RCA and mitigation list. Immediate follow-ups: 1) enforce header-preserve for healthchecks at egress level; 2) add synthetic healthchecks to detect header-loss earlier; 3) request Observix pre-deploy test or opt-out for header rewrite; 4) update runbook for Private VPC cross-region header-sensitivity.

cs_lead: Customer comms sent: short note + apology + link to ongoing RCA channel. Several customers acknowledged.

support_lead: No escalations to legal/security. No data exfiltration detected. Logging vendor (Observix) provided access logs for our review.

sam: Thanks all. Logging tasks: @alex @eng_platform please capture logs and timelines into the incident tracker and assign severity/impact for billing. Also queue a postmortem in incidents/postmortems within 48h.

alex: Will do. Attaching quick timeline in tracker: 11:58Z observed, 12:00Z incident declared, 12:07Z sidecar patch, 12:15Z passthrough ACL, 12:45Z vendor rollback, 13:00Z mitigated.

(closure)

maya: Closing thread — moving to postmortem doc. Thanks everyone for fast response. :thumbsup:
